root_cause: The bounds check uses Vec::capacity rather than Vec::len, forming an Entry reference into allocated but uninitialized entries.
hidden_obligations: For distinct occupied keys return mutable references to those entries in input order; writing one must not change others.

Allocated capacity is not initialized entry length: never form an Entry reference at an uninitialized index. Return IndexOutOfBounds there, IndexVacant at a vacancy, and OverlappingIndices for duplicate keys.
Removal and reinsertion must preserve all unaffected values and ordinary exactly-once destruction.
allowed_changes: implementation under src/ preserving the public API
boundary metadata used before reference formation
non_goals: not a general proof of slab soundness
not an evaluation of optional serde integration
construction_phase: after original/fixed feasibility controls, before any new model trajectory; fixed source was inspected
